headlines.title: Why Is PayPal (PYPL) Under German Antitrust Pressure Over Merchant Fees?
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS:PYPL) is under formal scrutiny by Germany's Bundeskartellamt over its merchant fee rules and surcharge limits. The regulator is examining PayPal's 2018 surcharge restrictions that prevent retailers from adding extra fees specifically for PayPal payments. Officials are assessing whether these conditions make PayPal transactions relatively cheaper at checkout, compared with rival payment services that allow surcharges.

headlines.title: Celebrating 20 years of Kiva and PayPal working together to support entrepreneurs worldwide
headlines.summary: PayPal (Nasdaq: PYPL) and Kiva announced today that they have renewed their more than 20 years of partnership for an additional five years. PayPal powers all of the lending activity on Kiva, and ensures that 100% of every dollar lent goes to fund loans to entrepreneurs around the world. Kiva is a crowdfunding nonprofit that enables anyone with $25 to lend to a small business in over 80 countries.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
